changelog_text:
## Changes
- The map reads the mission of your vessel (set in the vehicle editor's Life Support window or in flight). When the map opens with nothing selected and the universe uses life support, it selects the mission route with the mission's arrival (flyby, orbit or land) and trip (one way or return); after arrival on a return mission it selects the way home. Your own pick is never overridden, and **MISSION ROUTE** selects it again on demand.
- The route panel shows the stock mission timing for the selected route: out, stay, back and total, with the stay rounded up to the next return window and the wait for that window as its own row. Set the stay for any route in **STAY AT DESTINATION**.
- A crewed vessel shows whether its air, water, food and CO2 scrubbers last the whole mission, or which supply runs short, by how long and in which habitat zone, from the game's own life support forecast.
- An uncrewed vessel shows how long its probe core power lasts against the mission time.
- **SET AS MISSION** writes the selected route into the vessel's mission (destination, arrival, trip, stay, and the cruise speed for an interstellar route), in the editor as an undo step and in flight.
- In flight, an in-system route has a button that opens the stock Transfer Planner on its Hohmann plan with your vessel and the route target preselected.
- The transfer window list has a **Stay** column: how long to wait at the destination for the return window.
- Orbits very close to parabolic count as open or bound the same way the game decides it.
- The stock planner buttons keep working after a vessel was removed or a smaller save was loaded.
- Transfer-window countdowns to inner planets now show the time until the next window, and the ejection gizmo measures the angle from prograde for an outer target or retrograde for an inner target.
- Plane changes between sibling orbits at the same distance now have a nonzero cost, including routes to Jupiter's trojans.
- The available delta-v updates when a sequence's VAC/ATM setting, engine sequence or tank propellant use changes. Switching vessels around the same body updates the map's current-state marker.
- An interstellar departure that is already too fast now includes the braking burn.

Retrograde window countdowns still use the stock rule. Plane-change estimates for stars orbiting a barycenter are approximate.

## Compatibility
Validated against KSA build version **2026.11.16.5901**. This version needs KSA 2026.11.16.5901 or later; on older builds use v1.5.6.

## Installation
Extract into `Documents\My Games\Kitten Space Agency\mods\DeltaVMap\`.
Requires [StarMap](https://github.com/StarMapLoader/StarMap).

listing.name: DeltaVMap
listing.abstract: An interactive, auto-generated delta-v subway map and transfer-window planner for Kitten Space Agency.
listing.description:
It reads the loaded solar system live, so it works with any system, stock or modded, with no per-system setup.

![The Delta-V Map rooted at Earth](ksa-image:delta-v-map)

This mod is written against the [StarMap loader](https://github.com/StarMapLoader/StarMap).

## What it does

The map tells you "where can I go from where I am and for how much delta-v".
The transfer-window layer answers the "and when do I leave" question.

Both are generated from the loaded `CelestialSystem`, recurse through every planet, moon, asteroid and comet, and read each body's mass, radius, SOI, orbit and atmosphere. Nothing is hardcoded.

All numbers are closed-form patched-conic estimates (Hohmann transfers with Oberth-combined departure and capture, no iterative solver), so the whole map is fast and every transfer is cached once per session.

The delta-v figures are the idealized optimal values, so they assume a well-timed, well-flown transfer. A "piloting-margin percentage" slider is available.

## Features

### Delta-v subway map

- **Ego-centric metro layout.** The body you are currently in is the root; the map re-roots automatically on the next open after an SOI change, and Shift-Click re-roots to any body on demand.
- **Accurate budgets.** Closed-form Hohmann transfers with Oberth-combined ejection and capture, a per-body state ladder (surface, low orbit, stationary, SOI edge, intercept) and a "you are here" marker at your actual orbit.
- **Route planning.** Click any body to highlight the exact route from your current state, with a running total and a per-segment breakdown. Toggles for from-surface, landing, aerobraking, plane change and a return trip, plus a piloting-margin percentage to budget for non-optimal flying.
- **Vehicle comparison.** A bar compares the selected route against your ship's available delta-v.
- **Readable at scale.** Node-symbol vocabulary with a legend, search / focus / isolate, and automatic minor-body aggregation so a dense system (thousands of asteroids) stays usable.
- **Three layout modes**, switched from the on-canvas toggle or the Options menu:

**Cumulative-down (default)**

![Cumulative-down layout](ksa-image:delta-v-map)

**Gravity-well**

![Gravity-well layout](ksa-image:layout-gravity-well)

**Spring**

![Spring layout](ksa-image:layout-spring)

### Transfer windows

The timing companion to the map. For the root body and every sibling sharing its parent, it shows the optimal phase angle, the live current phase, a countdown to the next window, the synodic period, the ejection angle and the transfer time, in a compact list plus a live polar phase-clock.

![The transfer-window list and phase clock](ksa-image:transfer-windows)

A separate, opt-in layer draws the same data in the game's 3D map mode: the optimal-departure marker on the destination's real orbit (where it will be when the window opens), the planet-star-planet phase angle, and an ejection-angle gizmo at the departure body.

![The transfer-window overlay in the game map mode](ksa-image:map-mode-overlay)

## Installation

1. Install [StarMap](https://github.com/StarMapLoader/StarMap).
2. Download the latest release from the [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/Maximilian-Nesslauer/KSA-DeltaVMap/releases) tab or from [SpaceDock](https://spacedock.info/mod/4294/DeltaVMap).
3. Extract into `Documents\My Games\Kitten Space Agency\mods\DeltaVMap\`.
4. The game auto-discovers new mods and prompts you to enable them. Alternatively, add to `Documents\My Games\Kitten Space Agency\manifest.toml`:

```toml
[[mods]]
id = "DeltaVMap"
enabled = true
```

Open the map from the **View** -> "Delta-V Map" menu in flight, or the top-level **Delta-V Map** tab in the editor.

## Dependencies

- [StarMap](https://github.com/StarMapLoader/StarMap): Mod loader, required at runtime (see Installation). Tested version 0.4.6.

## Build dependencies

Required only to build the mod from source. Targets **.NET 10**.

- [StarMap.API](https://github.com/StarMapLoader/StarMap) from NuGet, tested version 0.3.6.
- [Lib.Harmony](https://www.nuget.org/packages/Lib.Harmony) from NuGet, tested version 2.4.2.

## Mod compatibility

- Known conflicts: none
